title: WorkX Premium Access
tagline: An NFT that is an access pass to the premium features on the Work X platform.
description: The Work X Genesis NFT grants access to premium features on the Work X platform. It has a staking mechanism where $WORK tokens can be staked in it to increase it's level. Higher level unlocks more features. The tokens can be regained by destroying the NFT, after a lock period has completed.
how_its_made: This project uses solidity for its smart contracts, hardhat for automation, typechain to type and waffle and chai for testing. It has a complex staking and leveling mechanism where not just any amount of tokens can be staked at any time, but a daily staking allowance is granted that builds up over time. At a later stage we plan to reward NFT's with tokens so unstaking "surplus" is possible at 10 level intervals without destroying the NFT. All tokens can be reclaimed by destroying the NFT, which will increase it's rarity. The NFT mint is free except for usual gas costs.
